builders.name: Godrej Properties
builders.about: Listed developer, part of the Godrej Group. Large Bengaluru pipeline across the eastern and northern corridors, mostly JD/JV land-light launches.

builders.name: Prestige Group
builders.about: Bengaluru-headquartered developer with the largest residential pipeline in the city, spanning apartments, plotted development and villas.

builders.name: Assetz Property Group
builders.about: Singapore-origin developer focused on Bengaluru, known for design-led mid-to-premium apartments in the east and north.

builders.name: Sobha Limited
builders.about: Backward-integrated luxury builder that runs its own concrete, joinery, glazing and interior divisions rather than subcontracting them.

builders.name: Puravankara Limited
builders.about: One of Bengaluru's oldest developers, running the premium Purva brand alongside the affordable Provident Housing arm.

builders.name: Brigade Enterprises
builders.about: Diversified Bengaluru developer spanning homes, offices, malls, hotels and schools, known for large mixed-use campuses.

builders.name: Sumadhura Group
builders.about: Premium residential developer concentrated on the Whitefield-Kannamangala corridor in east Bengaluru, also active in Hyderabad.

builders.name: Vajram Group
builders.about: Bengaluru-focused developer working the northern corridor around Thanisandra, Jakkur and the airport road.

builders.name: DS-MAX Properties
builders.about: Bengaluru's highest-volume affordable housing developer, working almost entirely within the city's northern and western belts.

builders.name: Nischitha Properties
builders.about: Local Bengaluru North developer working plotted residential layouts in the Doddaballapura and Madhure belt.

builders.name: Birla Estates
builders.about: Real estate arm of Century Textiles, part of the Aditya Birla Group. Entered Bengaluru with large master-planned developments in the north.
